name: Scrum Master 3
say: A Scrum Master is a servant-leader and coach who is accountable for establishing Scrum and helping their team work effectively within it. They do not manage the team or tell people what to do; instead, they guide the team in self-management, help remove obstacles blocking progress, and facilitate key Scrum events to ensure they stay productive and on track.
